checks.check: creating a challenge earns 0 XP by itself
a signed-in recipient starts one official attempt
the recipient's run resumes badged as a challenge
the attempt completes and is compared (the browser holds no bearer; the attempt keeps the account it was started under)
the recipient earns challenge completion XP once
victory XP only when the comparison decided recipient
FIRST CHALLENGE unlocks for the recipient
the creator earns one response (+25) and CHALLENGER (+50 the first time)
completing again: already_completed, recipient delta 0, creator unchanged
copying a link is a client action with no server call
